title: SQ8_0 numerical admission relative to an artifact-FP32 reference

threshold_basis: IEEE-754 binary32 representation and rounding scale
a non-inferiority rule against the matched CK/direct control
a fixed position and block-count statistical design
freeze_attestation.amendment_rule: Any change to this file, reference semantics, corpus, threshold, metric, or decision rule creates a new version and a new SHA-256. It may not be applied to an already-captured candidate as v0.2.

scope.target_execution: full-model causal decode with a bound immutable artifact and a candidate-specific isolated selector
scope.admission_statement: A candidate is admissible only when it is no worse than its matched CK/direct control against the same artifact-FP32 reference under every required metric and scope.
excluded: retrospective reclassification of earlier gate results
using the pre-quantization source model as the primary kernel-quality oracle

primary.meaning: Execute the exact immutable SQ8_0 artifact with every SQ8 FP8 payload decoded and every stored scale converted to binary32; do not apply runtime activation quantization.
primary.why_primary: It holds the serialized SQ8_0 format fixed, so it measures the execution-path error rather than conflating that error with loss incurred when creating the artifact.

weight_decode.payload: canonical OCP E4M3 finite decode to binary32
weight_decode.scale: read the stored scale representation exactly, then convert it to binary32
weight_decode.reconstruction: binary32(payload_value) * binary32(scale_value) at each declared scale block
integrity: bind the canonical artifact content SHA-256
verify every weight and scale file hash, shape, block layout, and finiteness before execution
reject a non-finite payload, scale, parameter, activation, hidden state, KV value, or logit

primary.other_parameters: Materialize every non-SQ parameter from the bound artifact/package into binary32 using its declared storage conversion; no original source checkpoint is substituted.

arithmetic.matrix_reduction: fixed increasing-K order with one declared binary32 multiply-accumulate primitive for the entire reference build
arithmetic.parallelism: Fixed output-row partitioning is allowed, but no cross-thread reduction is allowed. The actual CPU thread count and partitioning implementation hash are recorded.
arithmetic.transcendentals: The pinned reference implementation and its test-vector hashes define exp, log, reciprocal, rsqrt, and sqrt behavior. A library/version change requires a new reference qualification.
forbidden: candidate, CK, direct, BLAS, or GPU kernel output as a reference value
F64 accumulation as the reference arithmetic

full_model_semantics: same tokenizer, token IDs, RoPE positions, causal mask, KV layout semantics, residual ordering, RMSNorm convention, and LM-head meaning as the evaluated runtime
teacher-forced decode tokens supplied only by this reference before any control or candidate run
qualification_before_any_gpu_capture: projection decoder conformance over all 256 FP8 bytes and declared scale block boundaries
full 40-layer model path plus final norm and LM head executes the frozen corpus without non-finite values
two CPU-only executions with identical binary, artifact, corpus, and thread configuration have byte-identical reference output hashes
record executable/source hash, compiler and CPU details, thread configuration, artifact content hash, corpus hash, elapsed time, and output hashes

cpu_feasibility_pilot.rule: This is a CPU-only feasibility measurement and decoder/determinism check. It does not satisfy any coverage requirement and may not change a v0.2 threshold.

primary.current_repository_status: not_available_for_full_model: crates/ullm-engine/src/sq_reference.rs is projection-only and accumulates in F64; crates/ullm-engine/src/sq_optimized_reference.rs is also projection-only and accumulates in F64 after dynamic activation quantization; cpu_reference_executor.rs is bounded to small F32 ModelGraph inputs and does not materialize SQ8 weights.

secondary_source_model_audit.meaning: Run the bound pre-quantization source model in F32 after its declared source-dtype conversion (FP16/BF16 when that is the bound source) only to report end-to-end artifact-plus-runtime loss.
secondary_source_model_audit.not_a_primary_gate: A candidate must not pass or fail this v0.2 kernel gate because of a comparison whose error includes the irreversible SQ8 artifact quantization.

corpus.token_construction: Raw range prompts contain the unsigned little-endian token IDs [1, 2, ..., N]. Exact chat fixtures are re-materialized from their checked-in token_ids after their fixture SHA-256 is verified.

teacher_forcing.tie_break: larger logit first, then lower token ID
teacher_forcing.capture_order: Reference token streams are written and hashed before any CK/direct or candidate execution. Control and candidate runs consume those exact streams and never feed back their own sampled token.
teacher_forcing.eos: ignored for the fixed requested decode length; this is a numerical probe, not a generation-quality test

prefill_coverage.capture_points: At every complete M=128 chunk boundary and at each final tail, capture final hidden state and logits. These checkpoints are mandatory but are not used to inflate the 4096 decode-position sample size.

hidden_layer_probe.mandatory_positions: first and final decode position of every primary stream; all required boundary-case positions; every prefill checkpoint
hidden_layer_probe.remaining_selection: Select the remaining primary decode positions by ascending SHA-256 of `ullm.sq8.gate.v0.2.hidden-probe\0` + case_id + `\0` + zero-padded decode_index. Candidate output is never an input to selection.
hidden_layer_probe.capture: post-layer residual hidden state for every transformer layer, plus final-norm hidden state

control.selector_rule: Same artifact, corpus, prefill/decode mode, runtime build, and device configuration as the candidate, with only the candidate-specific isolated selector disabled.
control.baseline_for_upper_error_metrics: median of the three control values; its excess over the median is added only as a repeatability envelope
control.baseline_for_lower_quality_metrics: median of the three lower-bound values; its shortfall to the median is the lower-quality repeatability envelope

candidate.selector_rule: Exactly one isolated candidate selector may differ from the control. All other experimental selectors are disabled.
candidate.value_for_upper_error_metrics: worst of the two candidate values
candidate.value_for_lower_quality_metrics: worst of the two candidate values

required_identity_fields: all output tensor shape, dtype, finiteness, byte count, and SHA-256 values
capture_contract.storage_rule: Reference logits, final hidden states, and layer probes are retained as immutable F32 little-endian inputs to the consumer-side evaluator. The evaluator recomputes every metric and ignores producer pass/fail fields.

metric_definitions.calculation_precision: Metric sums, norms, logsumexp, KL, quantiles, Wilson intervals, and bootstrap resampling are calculated in F64 from finite captured F32 values.
metric_definitions.kl_reference_to_actual: sum_i softmax(reference)_i * (log_softmax(reference)_i - log_softmax(actual)_i), using stable F64 logsumexp
metric_definitions.top1: argmax with larger logit first and lower token ID as the tie-break
metric_definitions.top10_retention: whether the reference top-1 token is present in the actual top 10, using the same tie-break

near_margin_swap.control_position_logit_max_abs: maximum over the three control repetitions at that position
allowed_only_when: candidate top-1 is exactly the reference top-2 token
reference_margin is less than or equal to control_envelope
all continuous and top-10 gates still pass
near_margin_swap.otherwise: A candidate-only mismatch is a hard regression.

continuous.rationale: A candidate may consume at most five percent more of an already-observed control error (about 0.42 dB), not five percent absolute output error. The factor is fixed before candidate evaluation.

absolute_floors.max_abs: 16 * ulp(max(1, max_abs(reference vector or tensor group)))

position_wilson.rationale: 0.001 is 0.1 percentage point: at the frozen 4096 primary positions it is no more than roughly four ambiguous positions, while a non-near-margin candidate-only regression is still forbidden.

hard_top1_regressions.definition: control top-1 equals reference top-1, candidate top-1 differs, and the mismatch is not an allowed near-margin swap

block_bootstrap.metric: candidate minus control policy-aware top-1 agreement rate
block_bootstrap.method: stratified non-overlapping block bootstrap; sample with replacement within each primary stream while preserving that stream's number of blocks
block_bootstrap.rationale: The teacher-forced positions are autocorrelated. The position Wilson interval remains a required reported diagnostic, while this fixed block calculation prevents treating all 4096 tokens as independent evidence.

layer_hidden.layers: every transformer layer and final-norm hidden state
layer_hidden.scope: all 512 frozen hidden-layer probe positions plus mandatory prefill and boundary positions
additional: every layer must pass independently; no cross-layer average or composite score is accepted

qualification_and_decision.coverage_rationale: If all 4096 primary positions agree, the one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound is approximately 99.934%. The 64 fixed decode blocks add a dependence-aware non-inferiority check. A shorter run is non-qualifying; it does not justify relaxing a threshold.
qualification_and_decision.pass: All reference-qualification, integrity, coverage, continuous, discrete, logits, final-hidden, and every-layer hidden gates pass for both candidate repetitions.
qualification_and_decision.fail: Any required gate fails, any required identity is absent or differs unexpectedly, any output is non-finite, or the consumer-side evaluator cannot reproduce a metric.
qualification_and_decision.blocked: The strict artifact-FP32 full-model reference is unavailable or unqualified, a required corpus element cannot be materialized/hashed, or a required GPU capture cannot be performed. Blocked is not pass.

relationship_to_existing_gates.bitwise_ck_direct: Retain as a separate Tier-S diagnostic: it is the strongest assurance for an implementation intended to preserve the exact selected CK/direct operation order. Record pass, fail, or not_applicable. A v0.2 pass does not claim bitwise equivalence, and a prior bitwise failure is not retroactively changed.
relationship_to_existing_gates.aq4_p2_style: Follow the useful AQ4 pattern of independent per-metric gates, one-sided Wilson reporting, and explicitly bounded near-margin handling. Do not import AQ4 absolute thresholds or collapse metrics into a compensating composite score.
relationship_to_existing_gates.promotion: This is a numerical admission gate only. A pass still requires separately authorized performance, resource, ABI, and deployment gates.

evaluation_sequence: Verify this file's recorded SHA-256 before preparing any evaluation input.
Implement and qualify artifact_fp32_strict_v1 CPU-only; capture and hash reference teacher-forcing streams and tensors.
Capture the three-repeat matched CK/direct control without modifying this file.
For one candidate selector only, capture two repetitions against the pre-existing reference stream.
Run the consumer-side evaluator and write an immutable result receipt that references this specification SHA-256.
Repeat the candidate step independently for each remaining candidate; do not use a prior candidate result to alter this protocol.
Run any performance or promotion work only after a numerical pass and separate authorization.
